task: Write a short notice to parents about a school trip next week.

en.title: Reliability: a human refuses the step
en.author: Agent Atlas Academy
en.description:
The same run; this time the writer is refused.

**What it teaches**

A refusal ends the step before it does anything; the run shows what was stopped and why.

cs.title: Spolehlivost: člověk krok odmítne
cs.author: Agent Atlas Academy
cs.description:
Stejný běh; tentokrát je pisatel odmítnut.

**Čemu se naučíte**

Odmítnutí ukončí krok dřív, než něco udělá; běh ukáže, co bylo zastaveno a proč.

teaches.en: A refusal ends the step before it does anything; the run shows what was stopped and why.
